heading: Security Considerations
text: Keyring implementations SHOULD provide integrity guarantees for the encrypted data keys they return on OnEncrypt such that tampered versions of those encrypted data keys, if input into OnDecrypt, are overwhelmingly likely to cause a decryption failure (i.e. the chance of a successful decryption in this case is negligible).

heading: Security Considerations
text: Such integrity guarantees SHOULD include the integrity of the encryption context such that, if the encryption context used as input to OnEncrypt to produce an encrypted data key is different than the encryption context input to OnDecrypt to decrypt that encrypted data key, the decryption is overwhelmingly likely to fail.

heading: Security Considerations

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption
text: If the Keystore's AWS KMS Configuration is `KMS Key ARN` or `KMS MRKey ARN`, the `kms-arn` field of the DDB response item MUST be compatible with the configured KMS Key in the AWS KMS Configuration for this keystore, or the operation MUST fail.
note: kms-arn compatible with the configured key

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption
text: If the Keystore's AWS KMS Configuration is `Discovery` or `MRDiscovery`, the `kms-arn` field of DDB response item MUST NOT be an Alias or the operation MUST fail.

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption
text: When calling AWS KMS Decrypt, the keystore operation MUST call with a request constructed as follows:

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption
text: - `KeyId`, if the KMS Configuration is Discovery, MUST be the `kms-arn` attribute value of the AWS DDB response item. If the KMS Configuration is MRDiscovery, `KeyId` MUST be the `kms-arn` attribute value of the AWS DDB response item, with the region replaced by the configured region. Otherwise, it MUST BE the Keystore's configured KMS Key.

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption
text: - `CiphertextBlob` MUST be the `enc` attribute value on the AWS DDB response item

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption
text: - `EncryptionContext` MUST be the encryption context constructed above

heading: AWS KMS Branch Key Decryption
text: - `GrantTokens` MUST be this keystore's grant tokens.

heading: Record Format
text: A branch key record MUST include the following key-value pairs:

heading: Record Format > Branch Key Materials From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: The `type` attribute MUST either be equal to `"branch:ACTIVE"` or start with `"branch:version:"`.

heading: Record Format > Branch Key Materials From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: If the `type` attribute is equal to `"branch:ACTIVE"` then the authenticated encryption context MUST have a `version` attribute and the version string is this value.

heading: Record Format > Branch Key Materials From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: If the `type` attribute start with `"branch:version:"` then the version string MUST be equal to this value.

heading: Record Format > Branch Key Materials From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: - Branch Key MUST be the decrypted branch key material

heading: Record Format > Branch Key Materials From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: - Branch Key Id MUST be the `branch-key-id`

heading: Record Format > Branch Key Materials From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: - Branch Key Version The version string MUST start with `branch:version:`. The remaining string encoded as UTF8 bytes MUST be the Branch Key version.

heading: Record Format > Branch Key Materials From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: - Encryption Context MUST be constructed by Custom Encryption Context From Authenticated Encryption Context

heading: Record Format > Custom Encryption Context From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: For every key in the encryption context the string `aws-crypto-ec:` + the UTF8 decode of this key MUST exist as a key in the authenticated encryption context.
note: Custom EC from the authenticated EC

heading: Record Format > Custom Encryption Context From Authenticated Encryption Context
text: Also, the value in the encryption context for this key MUST equal the value in the authenticated encryption context for the constructed key.
note: Custom EC from the authenticated EC
